title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Jira/Xray , garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir cobertura e eficácia aplicando técnicas de caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.
  • Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) .
  • Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines.
  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .
  • Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin.
  • Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Vivência com smoke testing .
  • Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento) .
  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

  • Ensure all pages are fully functional, user-friendly, and properly tracking traffic sources (especially Facebook Ads)

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: DBA de Oracle
description:
DBA Oracle Pleno


Prime DB Solutions | Remoto | PJ | Período Noturno (18h às 00h)


Sobre a Prime DB Solutions


A Prime DB Solutions é uma consultoria especializada em dados, banco de dados, cloud e infraestrutura , com mais de 14 anos de atuação no mercado.


Reconhecida pela Oracle como uma das principais referências em Oracle Cloud na América Latina por três anos consecutivos , também somos Oracle Partner e Microsoft Partner , atuando em projetos de missão crítica para empresas de diversos portes.


Nosso modelo de atuação é consultivo e altamente técnico , com forte proximidade com clientes e foco em entrega de valor. Aqui, você trabalhará diretamente com ambientes reais e desafiadores, interagindo com times técnicos e áreas de negócio.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Formato: 100% remoto
  • Horário: 18h às 00h (turno noturno)
  • Equipamento: Necessário possuir notebook próprio adequado para execução das atividades


Sobre a Oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) DBA Oracle Pleno que seja proativo e disciplinado para atuar em atendimentos de chamados de sustentação de ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade , com foco em monitoramento e resolução de problemas no período noturno.


O profissional terá atuação direta com clientes, participando de incidentes, análises de performance e melhoria contínua dos ambientes.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes e problemas em ambientes Oracle, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços
  • Monitorar ambientes com ferramentas como Zabbix , atuando de forma preventiva
  • Executar rotinas de administração: backup, restore, manutenção e análise de ambientes
  • Realizar troubleshooting de performance (queries, waits, locks e consumo de recursos)
  • Analisar e otimizar planos de execução
  • Administrar ambientes Standby standard e Data Guard (monitoramento, GAP, switchover e failover)
  • Executar atividades de manutenção: reorganização de objetos, gestão de tablespaces e storage
  • Apoiar projetos de migração, upgrade e implantação
  • Garantir segurança e integridade dos dados (backup, criptografia, acesso)
  • Atuar em salas de crise , conduzindo resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Documentar procedimentos e atividades realizadas


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Oracle Database

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como DBA Oracle
  • Atuação em suporte a ambientes produtivos (nível N2)
  • Experiência com monitoramento (Zabbix ou similar )
  • Administração de Oracle 11g, 12c e 19c (23ai/26ai será considerado diferencial)
  • Experiência com RMAN (backup e recovery completo e pontual)
  • Conhecimento em Data Guard (GAP, switchover, troubleshooting)
  • Experiência com ASM (criação e gestão de diskgroups)
  • Conhecimento em performance tuning (AWR, ASH, planos de execução, índices)
  • Administração de Linux (nível básico a intermediário)
  • Gestão de espaço (tablespaces, datafiles, crescimento e reorganização )
  • Instalação e configuração de ambientes Oracle (on-premises ou cloud como OCI/DBCS)
  • Noções de segurança (usuários, roles, Oracle Wallet, TDE básico)

Comunicação e Consultoria

  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões técnicas (incidentes, GMUDs, alinhamentos)
  • Experiência em consultoria ou atendimento a múltiplos clientes simultaneamente


Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em:
  • Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Oracle (OCA, OCP e OCI)
  • Experiência com outros bancos de dados: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB


Perfil Comportamental

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva (técnica e com negócio)
  • Organização para atuar com múltiplos clientes e demandas simultâneas
  • Postura consultiva, com foco em melhoria contínua e geração de valor


O que oferecemos

  • Incentivo estruturado à certificação Oracle, incluindo apoio e direcionamento técnico
  • Acesso completo a trilhas de aprendizado em Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Atuação em ambientes enterprise e projetos de missão crítica , com alta exposição técnica
  • Contato direto com arquiteturas modernas de cloud, dados e alta disponibilidade
  • Remuneração alinhada ao mercado de consultoria, compatível com experiência e performance (modelo PJ)
  • 20 dias de descanso remunerado ao ano
  • Participação nos lucros (PLR) anual
  • Possíveis Bônus por performance

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines.   • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic

  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

custom-built agent workflows

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades


Apoiar na identificação, análise e tratativa de vulnerabilidades em sistemas operacionais e servidores.

Atuar na execução de aplicação de patches de segurança em ambientes Windows, Linux e Unix.

Apoiar a análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas de segurança, contribuindo para a priorização conforme criticidade, exposição e impacto para o negócio.

Contribuir com o controle, acompanhamento e redução do backlog de vulnerabilidades críticas e altas.

Apoiar o tratamento de vulnerabilidades relacionadas a hardening, versões desatualizadas de sistemas operacionais, componentes de infraestrutura e softwares de base.

Auxiliar na validação técnica de correções aplicadas, garantindo a efetividade da remediação e a evidência de conformidade.

Apoiar a análise de recorrência de vulnerabilidades e propor ações preventivas para redução de reincidência.

Atuar no acompanhamento de SLAs de remediação, conforme criticidade e políticas definidas pelo cliente.

Auxiliar na coleta, consolidação e análise de dados para elaboração de relatórios técnicos, indicadores operacionais e dashboards de vulnerabilidades.

Apoiar o levantamento de informações técnicas do parque de servidores dos clientes.

Garantir que as atividades sejam executadas em conformidade com processos ITIL (Incidente, Mudança, Problema e Configuração).

Atuar no suporte às atividades operacionais do time de infraestrutura e segurança.

Apoiar iniciativas de automação de tarefas operacionais, como coleta de informações, inventário de servidores, validação de status de patches e rotinas recorrentes.

Realizar análises críticas e validações de procedimentos em ambientes de alta complexidade e com elevado risco para o negócio.

Apoiar a tratativa de exceções, planos de ação e registros de risco quando a correção imediata não for possível.


Requisitos


Conhecimentos sólidos em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux/Unix.

Experiência com gestão de vulnerabilidades, atualização e correção de sistemas operacionais.

Conhecimento em análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas como scanners de segurança e capacidade de apoiar sua priorização.

Conhecimento em aplicação de patches de segurança, validação pós-implantação e troubleshooting básico em caso de falhas.

Conhecimento em processos ITIL.

Capacidade analítica e olhar crítico para validação de procedimentos e ações em ambientes complexos.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, como Zabbix, Grafana ou similares.

Conhecimento em scripts e automação, como Shell Script, Bash e Python.

Experiência com ferramentas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ansible, Terraform e IaC).

Experiência com ambientes de Middleware, como WebLogic, JBoss, Tomcat, entre outros.


Diferenciais


Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades, como Qualys, Tenable ou similares.

Experiência prévia em processos estruturados de gestão de vulnerabilidades.

Noções de classificação e priorização de vulnerabilidades com base em CVSS.

Conhecimento em hardening de sistemas operacionais e servidores.

Experiência com geração de relatórios executivos e técnicos sobre vulnerabilidades, exposição e remediação.

Vivência em ambientes críticos, com processos formais de mudança e janelas controladas para aplicação de correções.

Graduação em áreas de tecnologia da informação ou experiência equivalente.

title: SAP Business data migration expert (Manufacturing)
description:
For one of our international clients, RED Global is looking for an experienced SAP Business Data Migration Consultant with expertise in Manufacturing and Procurement processes to support a global S/4 Hana template rollout.


This is a remote role with occasional travel to Brazil, will focus on managing data migration activities in the Manufacturing and Procurement areas, ensuring data readiness, cleansing, and integration across multiple systems to support a seamless deployment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage business data migration activities, aligning with the Client’s deployment plan and milestones.
  • Coordinate and complete Manufacturing data cleansing tasks, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Oversee data collection for manual or construction objects, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with the Client’s IT to define and maintain value mappings between legacy and target systems.
  • Create and manage master data lists for assigned Commercial and Procurement objects.
  • Provide business insights to support data extraction and conversion from legacy systems.
  • Ensure Manufacturing data readiness throughout the migration lifecycle, including quality checks, validation, and defect remediation.
  • Verify data is suitable for intended Manufacturing processes, aligning with relevant stakeholders.


Desired Skills:

  • Minimum of 8+ years' experience in data migration and ERP implementations (S/4HANA)
  • Proven experience in SAP data migration, including data cleansing, mapping, and validation.
  • Strong understanding of Manufacturing, Commercial, and Procurement processes.
  • Experience in working with master data objects, including creation, management, and migration.
  • Experience in multi-country/global ERP deployment projects.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliation.


Details:

Start date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months with possible extension

Location: Remote + occasional travel

Rate: USD / day

Language: English + Spanish or Portuguese

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Posição temporária!


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Agentic Developer
description:

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

correctness and production readiness.

title: DevOps Engineer with Azure or AWS - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior experience as a DevOps Engineer, with experience with AWS or Azure - Mandatory .
  • Solid expertise in IaC tools, including Terraform and Ansible.
  • Advanced proficiency in Linux, particularly in infrastructure and container environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages, alongside programming skills (e.g., Python, GoLang).
  • Experience with DevSecOps principles and tools (e.g., mTLS, Single Sign-On, Certificates, Nessus, Clair, Inspec).
  • Practical experience with CI/CD approaches and tools, including GitHub Actions and GitOps.
  • hands-on with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge with Cloud Networking concepts.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Availability and interest in relocating to Portugal - Mandatory .
  • Availability to work in a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office) in Portugal (Lisbon or Oporto).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

- O que você deve ter?

Sólida experiência com Databricks e modelagem relacional (PostgreSQL )

Domínio de Python, SQL e processamento distribuído (Spark)

Experiência com AWS (plataformas de dados)

Vivência com arquiteturas Data Lake e/ou Lakehouse

Experiência prática com governança de dados (catálogo, linhagem, acessos e custos)

Capacidade de atuar ponta a ponta (ingestão → camada analítica)

Autonomia, proatividade e forte senso de dono

Estruturar a fundação de dados (governança, acessos, catálogo e controle de custos)

Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão e canonização de dados

Preparar dados para modelagem estatística e jurimetria

Garantir integração entre dados capturados (ex: crawlers) e camada analítica

Modelo 100% home office

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: UGC Content Creator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Freelance / Contract

Compensation: R$350 –R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)

Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week


About Pure

Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.

We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.


About the UGC Creator Community 

We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (TikTok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.

As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.


What You’ll Do

  • Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc)
  • Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
  • Drive people to the app 
  • Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
  • Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
  • Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies


What We’re Looking For

  • You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
  • Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
  • Familiarity with TikTok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
  • Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
  • Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
  • Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships


Payment Structure

  • Tiered structure paid weekly
  • Bonuses for views (starting from 100K+ views)
  • Bonuses for registrations
  • Payments are made weekly


Why Join Us

  • Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
  • Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
  • Build your portfolio while collaborating 
  • Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective


How to Apply

Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 

You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 

After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Salesforce System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce System Analyst

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion


Introduction:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration , effective Salesforce administration , and robust system configuration and implementation . The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce .
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third-party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) , Salesforce Platform App Builder , or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration , administration, configuration , and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)
  • Reporting and Dashboard tools within Salesforce
  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)


Skills:

Sales Cloud, Salesforce migration, Salesforce administration, Configuration, Implementation

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Jira/Xray , garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir cobertura e eficácia aplicando técnicas de caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.
  • Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) .
  • Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines.
  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .
  • Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin.
  • Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Vivência com smoke testing .
  • Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento) .
  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Analista de Negócios
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO


  • Levantar e documentar requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades e projetos.
  • Redigir histórias de usuários detalhadas, alinhadas às necessidades do cliente interno.
  • Analisar integrações e tecnologias, propondo soluções práticas e escaláveis.
  • Ser o ponto focal para dúvidas sobre processos de desenvolvimento e soluções voltadas para o mercado de seguros.
  • Redesenhar processos existentes, otimizando fluxos e resultados.
  • Identificar e mapear oportunidades de mercado, propondo melhorias estratégicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Experiência no setor de seguros: Vivência em corretoras ou seguradoras.
  • Experiência com Ferramentas do Google Workspace em nível intermediário (Sheets, Docs, etc.).
  • Desejável experiência com Jira e familiaridade com integrações tecnológicas.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, organização e transparência para atuar de forma colaborativa.
  • Ensino superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Conhecimento avançado sobre práticas e tendências do setor de seguros.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ


️ Auxílio Alimentação : para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos.

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais.

Assistência Médica SulAmérica : Cuidado completo para você e sua família.

title: Consultor SAP Datasphere
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Objetivo da Função

Atuar como especialista em SAP Datasphere em contrato temporário de 2 meses, apoiando o cliente na integração, preparação, modelagem e disponibilização de dados com governança e performance, garantindo a entrega de modelos e pipelines confiáveis para consumo analítico.



Escopo de Atuação (Principais Responsabilidades)

  • Desenhar e implementar integrações de dados via conexões (Connections) com fontes SAP e não-SAP, em ambientes cloud e/ou híbridos.
  • Configurar e operar pipelines de aquisição de dados (ex.: replication flows e data flows), com cargas iniciais e delta quando aplicável.
  • Modelar e organizar objetos no SAP Datasphere (Data Builder e Business Builder), criando visões/modelos com semântica de negócio.
  • Definir e aplicar padrões de governança e segurança no nível de Spaces, papéis e autorizações, garantindo acesso controlado e rastreabilidade.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e otimização de performance (cargas, visões, consultas), atuando em incidentes e ajustes de capacidade.
  • Documentar soluções (arquitetura, dicionário de dados, fluxos, runbook) e orientar o time do cliente/Atos em melhores práticas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com SAP Datasphere: Spaces, Connections, Data Builder e Business Builder.
  • Experiência com integração de dados e orquestração de cargas (replication flows/data flows), incluindo estratégias de delta quando suportadas.
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados (dimensional/relacional), conceitos de DW e semântica analítica.
  • SQL (preferencialmente SQL em SAP HANA/HANA Cloud) e boas práticas de performance.
  • Experiência com ambientes SAP (ex.: SAP S/4HANA ou ECC) e/ou ecossistema analítico (BW/BW/4HANA/BW bridge).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança/governança: papéis, autorização por space, controle de acesso e boas práticas de segregação.



Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: .

Acesse aqui o nosso aviso de proteção de dados para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos.

Privacy Notice


The personal data collected will be used exclusively for the recruitment process and processed according to the security guidelines introduced by Atos.

If you have any questions related to privacy or any aspect related to processing activities, you can contact us by e-mail: .

Click here to access our privacy notice and to get to know more about Atos processing of personal data.
