title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.

• Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.

• Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.


Job Description


A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot


Work Environment & Team Culture

• Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations

• Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture

• Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed

• Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail

• Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration

• Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions

• Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls

• Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraints


What Success Looks Like

• Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns

• Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment

• Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features

• Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture

• Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.


Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.


Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Business Development Representative (BDR) altamente orientado(a) a resultados para impulsionar a geração de novas oportunidades de negócios e a aquisição de novos clientes (new logos ) na Europa e em outros mercados internacionais.

Esta função é estratégica para a expansão das operações globais de BPO, sendo responsável por construir pipeline do zero, abrir novos mercados e posicionar as soluções da empresa em contas estratégicas .

Procuramos um(a) profissional com mentalidade hunter , forte disciplina comercial e ambição de crescimento, capaz de atuar com alto desempenho em ambientes internacionais competitivos .

Principais Responsabilidades


Geração de Pipeline (Outbound)

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes potenciais em mercados europeus.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de prospecção multicanal (cold calls, e-mails, LinkedIn).
  • Construir e manter um pipeline consistente de oportunidades qualificadas.


Desenvolvimento de Negócios (New Logos)

  • Abrir novas contas e gerar interesse em prospects que ainda não conhecem a empresa.
  • Posicionar a proposta de valor de BPO em segmentos-chave (atendimento ao cliente, vendas, back office, automação).
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões estratégicas com tomadores de decisão.


Qualificação e Handoff para Vendas

  • Realizar discovery inicial para entender as necessidades do cliente.
  • Qualificar oportunidades e garantir um handoff eficaz para o time de vendas (Account Executives).
  • Manter informações atualizadas e precisas no CRM.


Gestão de Performance e Métricas

Cumprir e superar KPIs exigentes, incluindo:

  • Pipeline gerado
  • Oportunidades criadas
  • Novos logos impactados
  • Atividades comerciais (ligações, e-mails, reuniões)
  • Metas de receita


Colaboração Interna

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, pré‑vendas e soluções.
  • Compartilhar insights de mercado para aprimorar campanhas e posicionamento.
  • Apoiar estratégias de crescimento regional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como BDR, SDR outbound ou em desenvolvimento de negócios B2B/B2C.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipeline e abertura de mercados do zero.
  • Vivência em mercados internacionais, preferencialmente Europa.
  • Inglês nível C2; espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares).
  • Forte orientação a resultados e atuação com metas desafiadoras.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, persuasão e negociação inicial.
  • Experiência em BPO, outsourcing ou serviços de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e ciclos de venda complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais e multiculturais.

Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.



About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Content & channels

  • Produce and distribute content across priority channels (LinkedIn, email, blog and future channels)
  • Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats
  • Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing


2.Brand consistency & messaging

  • Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints
  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets
  • Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives


4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Strong writing and content creation skills
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post
  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights

Must-haves

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Gerente de Soluções Trilingue
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.


Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.


Sobre a Posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Solutions Manager altamente estratégico(a) e analítico(a) para liderar a função de Pré‑Vendas de soluções de automação, RPA e Inteligência Artificial em um ambiente global de BPO .

Essa função é essencial para desenhar propostas de valor diferenciadas, definir estratégias de go-to-market e construir soluções que traduzam tecnologias complexas em valor de negócio tangível para clientes corporativos .

O(a) profissional ideal reúne visão estratégica, profundo conhecimento tecnológico e forte capacidade comercial , com habilidade para liderar processos complexos de pré-vendas e construir relacionamentos estratégicos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros .


Principais Responsabilidades


Estratégia de Soluções e Go-to-Market

  • Desenhar e liderar estratégias de go-to-market para soluções de automação, RPA e Inteligência Artificial.
  • Desenvolver propostas de valor diferenciadas e mensagens de negócio adaptadas a diferentes indústrias.
  • Identificar oportunidades para posicionar a automação como motor de transformação operacional e eficiência empresarial .
  • Criar ferramentas de marketing e vendas que apoiem o posicionamento das soluções.


Liderança de Pré‑Vendas

  • Liderar o desenho e a arquitetura das soluções durante o ciclo de pré‑vendas .
  • Traduzir requisitos dos clientes em soluções escaláveis de automação, IA e transformação digital .
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de vendas para viabilizar oportunidades estratégicas e complexas .


Relacionamento com Clientes e Apresentações

  • Desenvolver e apresentar apresentações comerciais de alto impacto para executivos e stakeholders-chave.
  • Atuar como consultor estratégico de confiança para clientes durante o processo de avaliação das soluções.
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e de negócio .

RFPs, Propostas e Pricing

  • Liderar a elaboração de respostas para RFPs, RFIs e processos de licitação .
  • Definir estratégias de pricing e modelos comerciais alinhados ao valor gerado para o cliente.
  • Coordenar equipes internas multidisciplinares durante a preparação das propostas .


Parcerias e Ecossistema

  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre clientes, equipes internas e parceiros tecnológicos .
  • Identificar oportunidades para fortalecer soluções por meio de alianças estratégicas e tecnologias parceiras .


Colaboração e Gestão de Relacionamentos

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de vendas, delivery, produto e marketing .
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros.
  • Apoiar o alinhamento interno sobre mensagens, posicionamento e capacidades das soluções .


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em Pré‑Vendas, Consultoria de Soluções ou Solution Management .
  • Histórico de sucesso na venda de soluções de RPA, Inteligência Artificial ou Automação de Processos .
  • Experiência sólida no desenho de estratégias de automação e iniciativas de transformação digital .
  • Profundo conhecimento do ciclo de vendas enterprise e gestão de oportunidades complexas .
  • Experiência na condução de RFPs, RFIs e licitações internacionais .
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação comercial e storytelling executivo .
  • Forte capacidade analítica, estratégica e de resolução de problemas .


Experiência Desejável

  • Atuação prévia em BPOs globais ou empresas internacionais de tecnologia .
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de automação, RPA e soluções de IA .
  • Experiência trabalhando com ecossistemas de parceiros tecnológicos .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack SR (Java/React)
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de Desenvolvimento. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs REST utilizando Java e arquitetura hexagonal (Ports and Adapters).
  • Liderar tecnicamente a modernização e migração de sistemas legados para soluções baseadas em Java e Spring Boot.
  • Definir e implementar adapters, barramentos de integração e camadas Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL).
  • Implementar arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona utilizando RabbitMQ (ou Kafka).
  • Otimizar queries SQL e NoSQL visando workloads transacionais e analíticos de alto volume.
  • Atuar fortemente em automação de testes (unitários, integração e contratos), CI/CD e qualidade contínua.
  • Monitorar performance, escalabilidade e resiliência das aplicações com foco em observabilidade.
  • Apoiar a squad na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos e decisões arquiteturais.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de dados e integrações com Data Lake para consumo analítico.
  • Colaborar com práticas de DevSecOps, garantindo segurança, governança e conformidade.
  • Definir estratégias avançadas de caching e otimização de latência (ex.: Redis, Caffeine).
  • Contribuir ativamente para padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e boas práticas no

ecossistema Java.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ampla experiência com desenvolvimento Backend Java (Spring Boot) e Frontend React.
  • Forte experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e APIs escaláveis.
  • Domínio de arquitetura hexagonal, DDD e Clean Architecture.
  • Experiência com mensageria avançada (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e event sourcing.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, Jenkins, GitLab CI e automação de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade, tracing e logging distribuído (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Experiência com DataOps, pipelines de dados e Data Lakes.
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes, cloud AWS, Azure e/ou GCP.
  • Atuação consistente em metodologias ágeis e squads multidisciplinares.


Informações Adicionais

  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto.
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

title: Aruba Network Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing?

  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise network infrastructure based on Aruba technologies.
  • Lead and execute migration activities from Cisco-based networks to Aruba environments.
  • Configure and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, switching, routing, and wireless networks in Aruba ecosystems.
  • Ensure network availability, performance, and security throughout all migration phases.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong hands-on experience with Aruba networking technologies (mandatory) .
  • Proven experience in enterprise network environments using Aruba switching and wireless solutions.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated experience in network migration or transformation projects.
  • Experience with Aruba ClearPass (network access control, authentication, and policy enforcement).
  • Experience with Aruba Central (cloud-based network management and monitoring platform).
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate from Brazil to Portuga l.



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: SAP PP/DS Expert  - 100 % Remote(back fill role)
description:
SAP PP/DS Expert - 100 % Remote(back fill role)

Candidate Locations – Mexico/Brazil/Argentina

Employment Type: 12 Months plus Contract

Start date – DOE


We are seeking an experienced SAP specializing in PP/DS (Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling) to lead the design and implementation of SAP supply chain planning solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP PP/DS, and end-to-end supply chain processes, along with the ability to communicate effectively in Spanish and English.

This role requires working closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to deliver scalable SAP planning solutions.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and architect SAP PP/DS solutions aligned with business requirements and enterprise architecture.

• Lead end-to-end SAP PP/DS implementations, upgrades, and optimization initiatives.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate supply chain planning requirements into SAP solutions.

• Configure and optimize Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling processes including:

• Demand planning integration

• Production planning

• Capacity planning

• Detailed scheduling

• Review functional and technical specifications to ensure alignment with architecture standards.

• Support testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Mentor junior consultants and provide thought leadership on SAP supply chain planning solutions.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Na CWI Software, estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java para atuar 100% remoto, em contrato CLT, junto a um cliente do segmento financeiro de grande porte, referência no mercado nacional.


Você irá atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, com alto rigor técnico, segurança e escalabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para soluções críticas e estratégicas no setor financeiro.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços back-end em Java 21+ (Spring Boot).
  • Participar ativamente da definição de arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas.
  • Realizar code reviews e apoiar tecnicamente o time na evolução da qualidade do código.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, documentação técnica e melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de UX/UI, backend, arquitetura, produto e negócio.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Java
  • Experiência com Java 21+, utilizando Spring Boot.
  • Boa compreensão de APIs REST, integração entre sistemas e microsserviços.
  • Vivência com testes unitários (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, JUnit, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações, performance e observabilidade.
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no segmento financeiro.
  • Atuação em projetos de larga escala e alto volume de usuários.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com Git
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com visão crítica e foco em qualidade.


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso dos nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento e bem-estar das pessoas. Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e com reais oportunidades de crescimento profissional, valorizando a excelência técnica e a troca de conhecimento.


Vem construir soluções de alto impacto com a gente!

title: Kronos Business Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!


For over 27 years , UST has worked alongside the world’s leading companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation.


Together, with more than 39,000 employees across 30 countries , we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role


The Kronos / UKG WFM Business Analyst is responsible for analyzing business requirements and supporting the implementation, configuration, upgrade, and integration of UKG Workforce Management solutions (formerly Kronos) .

The role works closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project managers to ensure successful delivery of WFM solutions aligned with business and operational needs.



Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Workforce Management (time & attendance, scheduling, labor rules, pay rules, etc.).
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical design specifications.
  • Configure and support UKG Workforce Management platforms (UKG Pro WFM / Workforce Central).
  • Support end‑to‑end implementation, upgrades, and migrations from WFC to UKG Pro WFM.
  • Design, execute, and support functional testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) .
  • Work closely with technical, integration, and offshore teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
  • Support data extraction, validation, and migration activities.
  • Coordinate with project managers to meet project milestones, timelines, and delivery commitments.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer to business users and support teams.
  • Support post‑implementation activities and ongoing enhancements as required.
  • Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.


Required Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7–10+ years of experience working with Kronos / UKG Workforce Management solutions .
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Central and/or UKG Pro WFM .
  • Advanced English Level - B2 + - C1
  • Solid experience in requirements gathering and functional solution design.
  • Experience supporting system testing, integrations, and UAT.
  • Understanding of WFM modules such as Timekeeping, Scheduling, Pay Rules, Activities, and Reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder and client‑facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently in complex environments.


Nice to have


  • Experience with integrations to HR or payroll systems (e.g., Workday, PeopleSoft).
  • Experience in system upgrades or consolidations.
  • Exposure to Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Multilingual skills (Spanish / Portuguese preferred for LATAM roles).


Conditions


  • Contractor - 5 months
  • 100 % remote
  • Colombia - Argentina - Chile or Brazil
  • Agile and highly collaborative technical environment.


We encourage you to apply or reach out for more information.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.

Não buscamos um desenvolvedor de sites WordPress. Buscamos alguém com experiência real em backend, que consiga trabalhar com sistemas complexos, integrações e performance em ambiente de produção.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel;
  • Trabalhar em uma arquitetura híbrida (Laravel + WordPress via Acorn);
  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços internos, WordPress);
  • Atuar em problemas reais de performance (queries, cache, Redis, processamento);
  • Refatorar código legado, melhorando estrutura e manutenibilidade;
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;
  • Realizar debugging e correção de problemas em ambiente de produção;
  • Contribuir na camada de apresentação utilizando Blade.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida com PHP moderno e Laravel em ambiente de produção;
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integração entre sistemas;
  • Domínio de MySQL/MariaDB (modelagem, índices, tuning de queries);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, organização de código, padrões);
  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas existentes e evoluir código legado;
  • Experiência com debugging e análise de problemas reais.


O que é um diferencial:


  • Experiência com WordPress (principalmente integração ou plugins customizados);
  • Familiaridade com Bedrock ou Roots Acorn;
  • Experiência com Tailwind ou stacks modernas de frontend;
  • Experiência com Redis, filas ou processamento assíncrono;
  • Experiência com AWS ou ambientes cloud;
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de deploy;
  • Experiência com aplicações de média/alta escala.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .


Sycomp complies with applicable AI regulations worldwide and adheres to the most rigorous standards. As such, our organization may use automated tools including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience and education. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at .

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


We are building an AI-first engineering organization where AI is embedded across the entire software development lifecycle — not as an experiment, but as core infrastructure.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer to help design and build the systems, agents, and standards that make engineering teams significantly faster using AI.


This is a builder role , not a research or ML modeling role.

  • Build AI agents for real engineering workflows (PR review, code generation, testing, debugging)
  • Embed AI across the SDLC (requirements → code → CI/CD → documentation)

  • Drive adoption of tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot
  • Create reusable patterns for AI-powered engineering workflows
  • Instrument and measure impact using DORA + SPACE metrics
  • Build lightweight AI infrastructure (AWS, LLM APIs, CI/CD integrations)

  • 8+ years in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Developer Experience
  • Strong Python engineering background
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs or Generative AI in production
  • Daily use of tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or workflows
  • AWS + CI/CD experience (GitLab preferred)


Strong differentiators (big plus)

  • Built AI agents or multi-agent systems
  • Experience with RAG, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases
  • Exposure to AI governance, guardrails, or FinOps (token/cost management)
  • Experience with DORA / SPACE metrics
  • Background in regulated industries (finance / insurance)


Important

This is not a Data Science or ML Research role .

We are looking for engineers who build AI systems that other engineers use every day .


Why this role

You will help define how an entire engineering organization uses AI:

  • Build production-grade AI agents
  • Standardize AI usage across teams
  • Create engineering “golden paths”
  • Directly improve developer speed and output


If you’ve been using AI tools and thinking “this should be embedded into how teams actually build software” — this is that opportunity.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

About Downtown Engineers

Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.



About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.
