  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.


Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades


  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .


Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;

O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems

Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Analista de Application Security (AppSec) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a segurança das aplicações desde o desenvolvimento até a produção, atuando de forma próxima aos times de engenharia para prevenir vulnerabilidades e fortalecer a cultura de segurança dentro dos projetos.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Segurança em IA: Atuar diretamente com squads de Inteligência Artificial, garantindo a segurança e resiliência de agentes autônomos.
  • Segurança Multicloud: Operar o hardening de ambientes (IAM, Redes, Gestão de Segredos) em AWS, Azure, GCP e OCI.
  • Cultura DevSecOps: Implementar e evoluir stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets) no GitLab CI/CD, garantindo automação total.
  • Parceria com Squads: Apoiar desenvolvedores na triagem, priorização e correção de vulnerabilidades via code review e práticas de Secure SDLC.
  • Proposição Técnica: Definir padrões de segurança para APIs (REST/GraphQL) e arquiteturas modernas, focando em soluções e não apenas em apontar problemas.
  • Disseminação de Conhecimento: Promover treinamentos e workshops para elevar a barra de segurança dos times de engenharia.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Perfil Híbrido: Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de software e transição consolidada para Application Security (AppSec).
  • Automação: Capacidade de desenvolver scripts (Python ou Bash) para automação de tarefas de segurança e resposta a incidentes.
  • GitLab: Experiência prática em configurar pipelines de CI/CD integrando ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk ou SonarQube.
  • Fundamentos de Cyber: Sólidos conhecimentos em autenticação, autorização (RBAC/IAM), WAF, EDR e OWASP Top 10.
  • Gestão de Segredos: Familiaridade com ferramentas de Vault (Hashicorp, AWS, Azure, GCP ou OCI).
  • Comunicação Proativa: Habilidade para transitar entre discussões técnicas de código e apresentações de métricas/soluções (powerpoint) para stakeholders.
  • Cloud: Conhecimentos de desenvolvimento em alguma das 4 clouds (AWS, GCP, OCI e Azure)


Diferenciais:

  • Domínio Técnico: Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise (Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk, SonarQube ou similares).
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Familiaridade com segurança em containers e ferramentas como Checkov ou Prowler.
  • Certificações: Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) ou segurança (Security+, CEH, CSSLP).
  • Modelagem de Ameaças: Experiência prática com Threat Modeling.
  • Segurança Ofensiva: Conhecimentos em PenTest, Redes e ferramentas como OWASP ZAP ou Burp Suite.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Tech Lead Ruby on Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\"The Rails Way\"), garantindo que a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile.
  • Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura.
  • Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog.


2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação

  • Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento.


3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance

  • Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.
  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Software engineer iii
description:

ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.
